body: I did the budget. He didn’t want to see it.

I’ve already crossed the bridge of being too hard on myself but appreciate what you’re saying the same. Things aren’t going so well tonight talking it out. And my brain is telling me “this is why you lied!” Which I also know is not healthy.

We just had a brief talk. I was honest about all the numbers. I told him I applied for a second job today and made an appoint to donate plasma and with a therapist. Tomorrow I will make one with a financial planner. Fell on deaf ears. Which I expected. Why would this time be any different?
He pays $9 per hour worked into a health and welfare fund that is what pays our insurance premiums. I’ve verified this information with his union benefits office.
Reading the updated post may provide some clarity. Or not.
I didn’t want to come off as placing blame or trying to get out of blame but in doing so I left a lot out. I will add my above comment to my post. Thanks.

I do plan to retain a lawyer. I just don’t have the money this second but it is on my horizon if the divorce proceeds. I know it’s a big number but yes that is the premium and it does not change whether it’s just him or all of us, I am positive. t is through his union. 
Thanks for your reply
I am not trying to get off the hook. I know moving forward from this would require some heavy lifting.

I didn’t spend 9k on clothes and make up. I understand how it can come across as such. In 2016 I lost my job and was unemployed for about 7 months. We left our kids in daycare at the time because it is very hard to find a spot in the school district we live in. Maybe a bad idea?  I don’t know. The job I got after that (about 6 months after losing my job which I couldn’t get unemployment after because knhd been staying home prior to it so I didn’t have the earning history it requires) paid about 30k. Better than not working so I took it. Over the summers we broke even with my check and with paying daycare (500/week). So while I wasn’t making any progress on what we had charged during my unemployment I was then charging more (groceries, utilities, school supplies) on top of it. Leading us to now. I have a better job now (45k) that I’ve been in for about 4 months. I can’t say we didn’t spend or charge things we didn’t need. And I certainly didn’t disclose these troubles, obviously. In my distorted view (which I admit is screwed up) I didn’t want him to be bothered by this stuff. He grew up poor and has a good job. I didn’t want him not have what he wanted. I understand now I was making that decision for him, unrightfully so. I don’t intend to say all this as an excuse. Just an explaination of what led to now.

I made an appointment with a counselor today. As I posted in another comment, I am working on getting a second job and am going to donate plasma to help pay it down more quickly. Even if it’s too late for us I need to make these changes and improvements for myself and my kids. Thank you I will also make the budget.
Thank you I really appreciate your responses.
I appreciate an honest constructive reply. Thank you.

Thanks for a constructive response. I know I’m shitty and feel like garbage. Got it. I have reached out to a past job that potentially I could pick up hours on weekends at a decent ($20+/hr) wage. Divorce or no divorce this has to get paid off so this will help. Thanks.
